text:
Mönchengladbach’s median asking rent sits at 10.0 €/m² in June 2026, up 9.3 % year‑on‑year and 35.1 % over the past five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. The premium over existing rents is 56 % (6.41 €/m² in the 2022 census), while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 600 € per month.  

The market is balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.2 % and listings spend an average of 31  days on market; 21 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 14.1 %, indicating moderate affordability pressure.  

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.49 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 10.21 €/m² and 10.71 €/m², a 4.9 % increase.
